$description: CLOSED assetRole vocabulary. GlassFlow is a real, live company. Every role has a closed availability (clone-only | generation-safe | blocked-for-generation), the policy for each PageSpec mode, generationSafeSubstitutes and generatedModeGuidance. availability, cloneModePolicy and generationModePolicy are pinned independently in extraction/verify_all.py and schema/semantic_validate.py (PINNED_AVAILABILITY): editing this file alone cannot loosen them. kind=media roles form the PageSpec assetRole enum; url/copy roles are content policies enforced by the GENERATION_MODE_* rules.

availabilityMeaning.clone-only: Real source media, reusable for fidelity in mode=clone only. In mode=generation it is rejected (GENERATION_MODE_ASSET) and one of generationSafeSubstitutes must be used instead.
availabilityMeaning.generation-safe: May appear in both modes. In mode=generation the ref must be generate:<brief>, placeholder:<id> or user-supplied:<id>; a source file (/assets/...) is still rejected (GENERATION_MODE_ASSET).
availabilityMeaning.blocked-for-generation: Source identity (trademark, real person, real customer, real product UI). Clone mode may reuse the exact file; mode=generation rejects it under its identity rule (GENERATION_MODE_BRAND / _PERSON / _CUSTOMER / _THIRD_PARTY / _SCREENSHOT) whatever the ref.

generationRefForms.generate:<brief>: a new asset generated from a written brief (8-200 chars)
generationRefForms.placeholder:<id>: a neutral placeholder from the renderer's placeholder library (lowercase id)
generationRefForms.user-supplied:<id>: operator media for the operator's own brand (lowercase id)

logo.third-party.guidance: Real third-party trademarks (Vercel, Claude, Cursor, OpenAI in the logo strip; investor firm badges). Reuse the exact clone files, unaltered, only where the source shows them. NEVER generate, redraw, recolour or add any other third-party logo; nominative use only, no implied endorsement beyond the source page.
logo.third-party.generatedModeGuidance: Never place a real third-party logo, wordmark or company name in a generated page. Use logo.placeholder-company (a neutral generated monogram for a fictional company) or omit the strip.

logo.customer.guidance: Real customer / backer logos (Restack, nubrain, Sentri, Entire, Weaviate, sference, case-study logos). Exact files only; never fabricate a customer logo or a customer relationship.
logo.customer.generatedModeGuidance: Never show a real customer/backer logo or imply a real customer relationship. Use logo.placeholder-company for a clearly fictional company (fictional name, .example domain).

brand.glassflow-mark.guidance: GlassFlow's own wordmark, product bar graphics, favicon. Exact files only; never redraw or generate a variant mark.
brand.glassflow-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Never reproduce, redraw or imitate the GlassFlow wordmark, bar graphics or favicon. Use the operator's own mark (asset.user-supplied) or a neutral brand.placeholder-mark.

brand.dither-mark.guidance: Dithered backgrounds that contain the GlassFlow stripe mark (e.g. the 'Two products' band image, inspected). Reuse exactly; generating lookalikes would counterfeit the mark.
brand.dither-mark.generatedModeGuidance: These backgrounds carry the GlassFlow stripe mark: blocked. Use a NEW abstract texture.dither-field with no mark, or an illustration.generated scene.

scene.mars-figurative.guidance: Figurative dithered Mars photography/illustration (astronaut hero band, mountain panels). GlassFlow brand art of unknown provenance/licence: reuse the existing files only, never generate new GlassFlow-branded scenes.
scene.mars-figurative.generatedModeGuidance: Branded GlassFlow scene art: clone fidelity only. A generated page uses a newly generated illustration (no astronaut/Mars-scene lookalike of the source files) or operator-supplied art.

texture.dither-field.guidance: Abstract dithered pixel fields used as decorative backgrounds (alt=""): no figures, no marks, no text. New ones MAY be generated using only Mars palette tokens (page/panel/deep/amber) and a square pixel dither; never imitate a specific GlassFlow scene.
texture.dither-field.generatedModeGuidance: Generation may use a NEW generated pixel field (generate:<brief>) or operator media (user-supplied:<id>); the source's own texture files (/assets/...) remain clone-only.

icon.pixel.guidance: Square pixel-grid UI glyphs (benefit, card, value icons). May be generated on a strict pixel grid in palette colours; never a third-party or GlassFlow logo.
icon.pixel.generatedModeGuidance: Generation may draw NEW pixel-grid glyphs (generate:<brief>); never a third-party or GlassFlow mark, never the source's own /assets/ files.

person.real-photo.guidance: Real people: testimonial avatars, founders, /about team and investors, team group photo. NEVER generate likenesses or substitute stock faces; use the exact clone file for that named person or omit the image.
person.real-photo.generatedModeGuidance: Never show a real person's photo, name or title (team, investors, testimonial authors, post authors) in a generated page. Use person.fictional-avatar with a fictional name.

product.screenshot.guidance: Real GlassFlow product UI (Tares/Rius dashboards, alert views, device visuals). Never generate or mock UI that claims to be the product; use exact files.
product.screenshot.generatedModeGuidance: Never reuse or mock GlassFlow product UI. Use screenshot.placeholder (a neutral wireframe labelled as a placeholder) or operator-supplied product imagery.

blog.cover.guidance: Covers belonging to real posts (posts.json thumb/cover). Reuse the post's own cover only; never generate a cover for a real post.
blog.cover.generatedModeGuidance: Covers belong to real GlassFlow posts: clone only. Generated posts use a generated illustration or operator media.

animation.lottie.guidance: The /rius retrospective Lottie JSON. Reuse exactly.
animation.lottie.generatedModeGuidance: The /rius retrospective animation is GlassFlow brand media: clone only. Generation uses a static generated illustration.

brand.placeholder-mark.guidance: A neutral geometric placeholder mark plus a fictional brand name, generated new (generate:<brief>) or from the placeholder library (placeholder:<id>). Must not resemble the GlassFlow bars/wordmark.
brand.placeholder-mark.generatedModeGuidance: A neutral geometric placeholder mark plus a fictional brand name, generated new (generate:<brief>) or from the placeholder library (placeholder:<id>). Must not resemble the GlassFlow bars/wordmark.

asset.user-supplied.guidance: Media supplied by the operator for THEIR brand (user-supplied:<id>): their logo, product shots, photos. The operator attests rights; the generator never fabricates these.
asset.user-supplied.generatedModeGuidance: Media supplied by the operator for THEIR brand (user-supplied:<id>): their logo, product shots, photos. The operator attests rights; the generator never fabricates these.

illustration.generated.guidance: A newly generated illustration or dithered scene (generate:<brief>) in Mars palette tokens; no figures copied from the source scenes, no marks, no text.
illustration.generated.generatedModeGuidance: A newly generated illustration or dithered scene (generate:<brief>) in Mars palette tokens; no figures copied from the source scenes, no marks, no text.

screenshot.placeholder.guidance: A neutral, clearly-placeholder UI wireframe (placeholder:<id> or generate:<brief>) labelled as illustrative; never claims to be a real product.
screenshot.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: A neutral, clearly-placeholder UI wireframe (placeholder:<id> or generate:<brief>) labelled as illustrative; never claims to be a real product.

person.fictional-avatar.guidance: A non-photographic or clearly fictional avatar (initials tile, abstract pixel portrait) for a fictional person; never a real person's likeness and never stock photos of real people.
person.fictional-avatar.generatedModeGuidance: A non-photographic or clearly fictional avatar (initials tile, abstract pixel portrait) for a fictional person; never a real person's likeness and never stock photos of real people.

logo.placeholder-company.guidance: A generated monogram/wordmark for a FICTIONAL company (e.g. 'Northwind Labs'); never a real company's mark or name.
logo.placeholder-company.generatedModeGuidance: A generated monogram/wordmark for a FICTIONAL company (e.g. 'Northwind Labs'); never a real company's mark or name.

url.placeholder.guidance: Outbound links, emails and embeds in generated pages use reserved placeholder domains only: hosts ending in .example or .invalid (RFC 2606/6761), or internal routes / in-page anchors. Enforced by GENERATION_MODE_URL / GENERATION_MODE_EMBED.
url.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Outbound links, emails and embeds in generated pages use reserved placeholder domains only: hosts ending in .example or .invalid (RFC 2606/6761), or internal routes / in-page anchors. Enforced by GENERATION_MODE_URL / GENERATION_MODE_EMBED.

copy.original.guidance: All generated copy is newly written: no source headings, taglines, testimonials, statistics or post text (5-word shingle match = GENERATION_MODE_COPY), no source numeric claims (GENERATION_MODE_CLAIM).
copy.original.generatedModeGuidance: All generated copy is newly written: no source headings, taglines, testimonials, statistics or post text (5-word shingle match = GENERATION_MODE_COPY), no source numeric claims (GENERATION_MODE_CLAIM).

decisionNotes.dithered-mars-photography: Split by evidence after inspecting the files: figurative scenes (astronaut hero band 8Cuc5..., mountain panel) and mark-bearing backgrounds (h0ej46... stripe mark) are must-reuse-exact; abstract pixel fields with no subject (D96x..., 7xhcz...) are may-generate-new within palette tokens. Files not individually inspected (e.g. ARgMq... quickstart bg, p8ih..., 5G4h...) are classified from their asset-manifest descriptions (specs/content-assets.md, specs/landing-assets.md): INFERRED.
